thoughts.subject: Diagnosing Selection Anomalies
thoughts.description: The "cannot change status" and "selection not respected" reports point to a bug in single-select. My investigation now focuses on `toggleSelection` and how it interacts with the `multiSelect` state. I found that in single-select mode, the `toggleSelection` function will add a selected image, but cannot deselect it, meaning this is the root cause of the "cannot change status" and explains why single-select mode feels broken.

thoughts.subject: Identifying a Critical Bug
thoughts.description: I've isolated a significant bug within `toggleSelection`. In single-select mode, the current implementation leads to a situation where items cannot be deselected, confirming the reports. The logic within `toggleSelection` is flawed, preventing the user from toggling a single selected image back to an unselected state. This needs immediate attention.
